doc.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Growing up and learning drums in Washington
title: Quartet with Frank Wess
summary: Cobb recalls his quartet with Frank Wess, pianist Rob Harley and a bassist, and a photo used on a CD.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you know – a lot of that came through Frank Wess. I think Frank was the first one, and he turned the Count on to these other guys

That’s probably right. I had a – I was in a band with Frank. We had a quartet. I was in his quartet. Recently he sent a photo that we had taken together, which was about – by the time I got it, it was about 50 years old. We’re looking [?]. We used it on one of our CDs that we put out – that Eleana put out. Eleana is my wife. She put out – we made this record. She produced this record. On the front of it is me, looking like I’m 18, which
I was, and a big bass drum. But they cut off the rest of the picture, which was him and a piano player named Rob Harley.
Rob Harley, Frank Wess, Ben Stuperville, I think was . . .
